question: The value of sin² 30 – sin² 40 + sin² 45 – sin² 55 – sin² 35 + sin² 45 – sin² 50 + sin² 60 is:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Use the complementary angle identity: sin² θ + sin² (90° − θ) = 1. Group the complementary angle terms: −(sin² 40° + sin² 50°) − (sin² 35° + sin² 55°) = −1 − 1 = −2. Sum the standard angle values: sin² 30° + sin² 45° + sin² 45° + sin² 60°. ⇒ (1/2)² + (1/√2)² + (1/√2)² + (√3/2)² = 1/4 + 1/2 + 1/2 + 3/4 = 2. Total value = 2 − 2 = 0. **∴ The correct answer is 0.**
